title: Scott Bessent Just Delivered One Stunning Fact That Left Trump Critics Speechless
text:
The Left’s been screaming about President Trump’s tariffs for months now.
They swore up and down that Americans would get crushed by sky-high prices.
But Scott Bessent just delivered one stunning fact that left Trump critics speechless.
Treasury Secretary destroys tariff fear-mongering with hard data Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent went on FOX News Sunday and completely obliterated the Left’s favorite talking point about tariffs.
Shannon Bream hit him with the usual media line – that 57% of Americans think tariffs will hurt the economy.
You know what Bessent did? He called her out right to her face.
"Well, I think there is a lot of misinformation out there. I think, you know, TDS (Trump Derangement Syndrome) as soon as you call them ‘Trump tariffs,’ 90% of Democrats hate them."¹
That’s when Bessent dropped the hammer on all those fancy economists who’ve been predicting doom and gloom.
"I’m going to have to disagree with Goldman Sachs and JP Morgan. The empirical data shows we have seen no inflation thus far, and we’ll see over the coming months."¹
Wait, what? No inflation?
But CNN told us we’d all be eating ramen noodles by now!
The Treasury Secretary wasn’t done schooling the media either.
"And Shannon, there is a big difference between inflation and a one-time price adjustment, also. Inflation is a generalized monetary phenomenon. We’re not going to see that. And thus far, we haven’t even seen the one-time price adjustment."¹
So much for all those "expert" predictions.
Foreign companies are eating the costs – not you Here’s where it gets really good.
Bessent revealed what’s actually happening with these tariffs, and it’s nothing like what the Never-Trumpers said would happen.
Foreign manufacturers aren’t jacking up prices on American families.
They’re swallowing the tariff costs themselves because they can’t afford to lose access to our markets.
"What we’re seeing is the business model for many of our trading partners, especially in Southeast Asia, is to produce, produce, produce. And the manufacturers in those countries are taking the price increases, or the tariffs, into their margins."¹
Let that sink in for a minute.
All those countries that have been ripping us off for decades? They’re now paying the price instead of passing it on to American consumers.
President Trump called this one perfectly during his campaign.
He said foreign companies would eat the costs rather than lose their golden goose – the American consumer market.
And guess what? He was right. Again.
Democrats’ economic "experts" look like fools Remember all those talking heads on MSNBC warning about economic catastrophe?
Remember the Wall Street Journal op-eds predicting massive price increases?
Remember Goldman Sachs and JP Morgan telling us tariffs would destroy the economy?
They were all wrong. Dead wrong.
This isn’t the first time the so-called "experts" have been completely clueless about Trump’s economic policies.
They said the same thing about his tax cuts – that they’d blow up the deficit.
They said deregulation would destroy the environment.
They said renegotiating trade deals would start trade wars.
Every single time, they’ve been wrong.
And every single time, Trump’s been proven right.
Why this drives the Left absolutely crazy You want to know what really gets under Democrats’ skin about this tariff success?
It’s not about protecting American consumers – they couldn’t care less about that.
It’s about protecting their globalist buddies who’ve been getting rich off unfair trade deals.
For decades, multinational corporations have made billions by shipping jobs overseas and importing cheap junk.
They’ve gotten filthy rich while American manufacturing towns turned into ghost towns.
Democrat politicians have been happy to play along because they get their campaign contributions and cushy board positions after leaving office.
Trump’s tariffs threaten this whole corrupt system.
Now these companies actually have to pay for access to American markets instead of getting it for free.
No wonder the establishment is losing their minds.
The real winners here So who’s actually winning from Trump’s tariff strategy?
American workers, for starters.
Foreign companies can’t undercut American manufacturers as easily when they’re paying tariffs.
American taxpayers are winning too.
We’re collecting revenue from tariffs instead of just letting foreign companies profit off our market for nothing.
And American families are winning because they’re not seeing the price increases Democrats promised.
Foreign manufacturers are absorbing the costs because they know they can’t afford to lose American customers.
It’s a win-win-win situation – unless you’re a globalist who’s been profiting off America’s bad trade deals.
Trump delivers results while critics eat crow The empirical data doesn’t lie.
Bessent just proved that Trump’s tariffs are working exactly as promised.
No inflation. No massive price increases. No economic catastrophe.
Just foreign manufacturers finally paying their fair share to access American markets.
Meanwhile, all those "experts" who predicted disaster are scrambling to explain why they were wrong.
They can’t.
Because they never understood that Trump’s economic policies are designed to put America First, not Wall Street first.
And once again, President Trump has delivered results while his critics are left eating their words.
